## Hypothesis

We are trying to improve edge capture on J winner days by adjusting exit parameters for SUPER, LEVEL, and TRENDLINE setups. Specifically, tightening the SUPER stop to -15% (from a presumed -20% baseline) and increasing the TP1/runner targets to let winners run longer, while adjusting LEVEL/TRENDLINE stops to avoid premature exits. The hypothesis is this increases 5/04 capture without increasing loser-day losses.

- SUPER: stop=-0.15, TP1=0.75, runner_target=3.0
